scope: Three exact replacements applied to new derived authoring copies; historical package and fulfilled office correction unchanged. Full candidate not yet approved.
exactReplacementParagraph: KEEP ordinary assay fees at 1% of the face value of the actual accepted assay bill, minimum 1 gp for that real service, and remint fees at 2% of the recovered legitimate metal value accepted for actual reminting. A combined commissioned assay bill receives its minimum once, not per coin, variant or thirty-minute stage; services not incurred create no fee, and an already-owned private testing toolkit creates no fictional desk fee to its owner. KEEP the Loop greater-of rule for a holder lawfully established to be knowing, not a 10% cap. NEW explicit total-payment and fee allocation: let F be the confirmed false lot's face value, A the actual assay fee, R the actual remint fee, and S=A+R for the same assessed lot/bill; the total monetary liability is P=max(0.10×F,S), allocated to service fees S and an additional criminal fine of P−S=max(0,0.10×F−S). Do not charge P plus those fees or levy another 10% fine on top. Compute on exact amounts under FL-21/EC-10's existing final-transaction copper rounding; allocating the total between fees and fine does not itself create extra transactions. Credit actual prior payments and fees already withheld from returned legitimate metal once against the same liability, leaving only its unpaid balance. Confirmed counterfeit coin or plated false currency is seized in full only through actual lawful authority; seizure is neither a fee nor a payment credit. Genuine coins and legitimate metal remain separately identified and are returned with actual fee deductions accounted for once. An innocent holder with documented provenance pays no criminal fine; absent a lawful knowing-holder finding, this rule imposes no criminal fine. Suspicion, ancestry, a failed die or missing documentation alone does not establish knowledge. Assessment, collection and custody require actual authorized actors; an unpaid amount remains an obligation, not automatic borrowing or remote confiscation. Cutting/reminting takes the provider's actual work and links consumed/replaced coin identities to real metal/output quantities without duplication.
